title: Who does each task
statement:
Give one line of text for every task, as one array of strings.

The input is an array of tasks. A line is the `title`, then `: `, then the `assignee`, for example `"Fix login: ada"`. When a task has no `assignee`, or it is `null`, write `nobody` in its place.

tests.expected:
[
  "Fix login: ada",
  "Write docs: nobody",
  "Update deps: nobody"
]
